data.name: Addul
data.gender_notes: Addul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'addala' meaning 'to serve'. In Islamic tradition, the name Addul is given to those who are devoted servants of God. The name Addul carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Addul usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying dedication and submission to God.
data.etymology: Addul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Addul total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عدول
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عدل، يعني الشخص الذي يعدل وينصف
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم 'عدول' مشتق من الجذر 'ع-د-ل' الذي يعني العدل والإنصاف. في اللغة العربية، يوصف الشخص الذي يتصف بالعدل والإنصاف بأنه 'عدول'. هذا الاسم يحمل معاني الالتزام بالقيم الأخلاقية والتصرف بنزاهة وإنصاف في جميع الأفعال والتعاملات. في السياق الإسلامي، العدل هو قيمة أساسية تشدد عليها الشريعة الإسلامية، مما يجعل اسم 'عدول' ذا أهمية كبيرة كونه يعكس صفات حميدة ومحببة عند الله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: عدول
in_urdu.meaning: عدول نام کا مطلب ہے جو انصاف کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عدول نام عربی زبان کی اصطلاح 'عدل' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے انصاف کرنا یا انصاف والا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشرے میں بھی مقبول ہے جہاں اسلامی اقدار کو انتہائی اہمیت دی جاتی ہے۔ عدول وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو ہمیشہ انصاف کے اصولوں پر چلتا ہے، سچ بولتا ہے، اور راستباز رہتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم اور اخلاقیات میں انصاف کی تاکید کو دیکھتے ہوئے، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अदूल
in_hindi.meaning: अदूल नाम का अर्थ है जो न्याय करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अदूल नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जहां 'अदल' का अर्थ होता है न्याय या निष्पक्षता। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन मूल्यों को दर्शाता है जो इस्लामी शिक्षाओं में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण माने जाते हैं। अदूल नाम का व्यक्ति न्यायप्रिय, सच्चा और ईमानदार माना जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, न्याय और निष्पक्षता पर जोर देने के कारण यह नाम विशेष महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: عدول
in_pashto.meaning: عدول د انصاف کوونکی شخص معنی دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د 'عدول' نوم په پښتو کې د انصاف او عادلانه چلند معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د پښتنو او افغانانو په کلتور کې د اسلامي ارزښتونو د يوې مهمې برخې په توګه ليدل کيږي. هغه څوک چې د 'عدول' نوم لري، داسې انګيريږي چې د انصاف پلوي کوي، سچ وايي، او په ټولو چارو کې نېک چلند کوي. په اسلامي شریعت کې د انصاف ټینګار، دغه نوم ته ځانګړی اهميت ورکوي.

in_english.name: Addul
in_english.meaning: Servant of the Just or One who is just
in_english.long_meaning: The name Addul is derived from the Arabic root 'a-d-l', which means 'to be just' or 'fair'. In an Islamic context, the name signifies a person who upholds justice, truth, and fairness. Historically, the name reflects the importance of justice in Islamic tradition and culture. It symbolizes the individual's commitment to ethical conduct and moral integrity. The name Addul is associated with positive personality traits such as honesty, reliability, and compassion.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عَدُول

data.cultural_impact: The name Addul holds significant cultural importance as it reflects the devotional aspect of an individual's character. In many Muslim communities, names are believed to shape an individual's identity and, to some extent, influence their behavior. With the name Addul, there is a constant reminder of the individual's role as a servant of God, thereby encouraging them to lead a pious and righteous life.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Addul lies in its association with devotion, servitude, and obedience to God. In Islamic belief, all human beings are servants of Allah, and the ultimate goal in life is to please and worship Him. By giving the name Addul, parents are instilling a deep sense of spiritual awareness and commitment to serving God, which can be a powerful source of inspiration and motivation throughout a person's life.

historical_references.reference: The Prophet Muhammad named his son Ibrahim 'Ibrahim ibn Al-Khalifah al-Abbas ibn 'Abdul-Muttalib', meaning 'Ibrahim, son of Al-Khalifah, son of 'Abdul-Muttalib'. 'Abdul-Muttalib was the grandfather of the Prophet Muhammad, and Al-Khalifah was his uncle.

The Umayyad Caliph 'Umar ibn 'Abdul-Aziz (682-720 AD) was known for his piety and just rule. He was called 'Abdul-Aziz, meaning 'servant of Aziz (Allah), because of his deep faith and devotion to God.'

In the music industry, artists such as Addul Khaeefa use this name to promote their Islamic identity through their music. In the fashion industry, 'Addul' clothing brands offer modern, stylish clothing lines that cater to the contemporary needs of Muslims while maintaining traditional values. This name reflects the balance between preserving cultural heritage and adapting to the changing world.
